{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Invader''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] that tried to stop the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuating]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Invader will arrive in the first mission of Tour of Duty 4 in X-wing if the Alliance [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] group [[Crescent (corvette group)|''Crescent'']] was destroyed.
